disputes.reason: Ambiguous without the scenario: a quanto converts at a fixed rate, so 'the exchange rate at which the amount will be converted' reads as false to a student; the seller's unknown is the spot rate needed to source the foreign currency.
False label rests on an unclear conversion-direction story that cannot be judged without the question; the hedging direction for the seller is arguable, so the card is not reliably false.

Explanation teaches something wrong: it says a put must be based on the minimum, but a put on the maximum (max[0, K - max(S,Q,C)]) is a valid rainbow payoff; the expression is invalid only because it is never positive.
